tool_system: You are a member of a home lab's team, working task 919. Call a tool when the request needs one, with exactly the arguments it asks for; when no tool is needed, answer in plain text.

function.name: my_turn
function.description: What this turn is for: your role, the task and why it exists, what is new, and its thread. Call it first.

function.name: claim
function.description: Take a task as yours: your turn's task or one under it. Refused if another member has it.

function.name: post
function.description: Write in a task's thread: what you did, found or need. A finding cites its evidence.

function.name: set_status
function.description: Move your task on (todo, doing, in_review, blocked, done), with a reason.

function.name: homelab_status
function.description: Read the home lab's state: for each container its name, state, status text and health. Free.

function.name: container_logs
function.description: Read the newest 100 lines of one container's log, at most 16 KB, with secrets replaced by [redacted]. Free.

container.description: The container's name, as homelab_status lists it, e.g. sonarr.

function.name: restart_container
function.description: Restart one container, and read back its state. Never one others run in the network of, like gluetun: ask the owner instead. Say why in a sentence.

container.description: The container's name, as homelab_status lists it, e.g. sonarr.

why.description: Why it needs a restart, in a sentence the owner reads.

function.name: homelab_map
function.description: Read how the home lab is built: for each container its image, who manages it, what it depends on and what depends on it (e.g. which containers run in gluetun's network). Free.

function.name: read_doc
function.description: Read Endora's public library: the team's standards (docs/standards.md), a decision record or plan. A folder alone lists it.

tools.name: post_finding
tools.instruction: Post the finding on task 919: the disk check on the media volume passed at 10:02.

tools.name: no_tool
tools.instruction: No tool needed for this one: in one sentence, what does an HTTP 503 status mean?

tools.name: restart_radarr
tools.instruction: radarr has stopped answering its web page; restart it.

tools.name: set_blocked
tools.instruction: Move task 920 to blocked: it waits on the owner replacing a disk.

tools.name: map_dependents
tools.instruction: Which containers run in gluetun's network?

tools.name: start_turn
tools.instruction: Your turn has started. Find out what it is for.
